en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural mountain scene with dense forest, a dirt road with a simple wooden guardrail, and a large timber building labeled as the 'Rehberger Grabenhaus'. A narrow man‑made water channel runs alongside the road, crossed by small wooden bridges. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place as Höhen-Kurort St. Andreasberg in the Harz mountains. Publisher information appears along the lower edge.
